detailed_description: The Image Splitter tool divides one uploaded image into a simple rows-and-columns grid directly in the browser. Choose a preset such as 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 2x3, or 3x2, or enter custom row and column counts from 1 to 10. After you upload an image, the page shows a grid overlay on the original image along with the source size and calculated part size. Click Split to create PNG pieces with Canvas, then download a single piece or download every piece together as a ZIP file.
usage_steps: Upload an image from the file picker.
Choose a grid preset or set the rows and columns manually.
Review the grid overlay and calculated part size.
Click Split to create the image pieces in the browser.
Download one piece from the preview or use Download All to save a ZIP file.
usage_examples: Split a banner into a 3x2 grid for a layout mockup.
Create equal image pieces for a simple puzzle or classroom activity.
Break a large illustration into smaller PNG tiles for review.
Download all generated pieces in one ZIP after checking the preview.

faqs.question: Can I download all pieces at once?
faqs.answer: Yes. After splitting the image, use Download All to save the PNG pieces inside a ZIP file.

faqs.question: What grid sizes are available?
faqs.answer: The page includes 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 2x3, and 3x2 presets, plus manual row and column inputs from 1 to 10.

faqs.question: Where does the image processing happen?
faqs.answer: The upload, preview, splitting, and downloads happen in the browser.

faqs.question: Can I download a single part?
faqs.answer: Yes. Hover a generated piece and use the download action for that part.
